notes: Synthetic test cases, not production data.
Expected outputs are test-set judgments. Approval expectations depend on the business policy implemented by your team.
For ambiguous approval cases, expected value is null and expected abstain is true as a desired behavior.
Evaluate aggregate performance on held-out data; a small manual dataset is not enough to establish calibration.
